'''September 2001 Rancho Cucamonga tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rancho, CA on 21 September 2001. [[Dan Lujan]] won it. It is known from Dunya Ertan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3059">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-where-heros-come-out-of-rancho-cad3059/ where-heros-come-out-of-rancho-ca], DeckTech (Dunya "Hardpack" Ertan, 15 October 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-10-15-where-heros-come-out-of-rancho-cad3059/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 September 2001
* '''Site:''' Rancho, CA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Dan Lujan]]
